## History

Lauretta was an eight-year-old child known for her fat, placid appearance and her irreproachable behavior in church since infancy. During a service, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) dropped a caterpillar down her neck.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_
